svg.title: YOLO-Seg instance-label contract
svg.desc: One PCB AOI has a replayable ROI, letterbox, tile, class, box, polygon or mask, ignore, and overlap contract for each known instance.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans TC, sans-serif

svg.text: 先定義「一個 object」：YOLO-Seg 的輸入不是只有一張圖

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans TC, sans-serif

svg.text: 固定 ROI／letterbox／tile；每個 known instance 要有 class、box、polygon/mask、ignore 與 overlap order 的可重播契約。
